llm.summary: The skill performs bounded public-topic research through Crawlora, with disclosed API use and proportionate access.

dimensions.detail: Queries go to the documented Crawlora API. The helper restricts routes and HTTP methods and prevents curl file-upload shorthand; confidential search terms still need user care.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains documentation and a bundled Bash/curl helper, with no remote code installation or automatic setup actions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions limit sampling and retries, prohibit challenge bypass, and require agreement before substantially expanding billable collection.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The supplied API key is temporarily stored in a private curl configuration with exit cleanup. No background workers, persistent configuration changes, or local session-store access appear.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Search, trend comparisons, and selected public comments or transcripts directly support the stated research purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use search terms you are comfortable sharing with Crawlora and the relevant search services. Remove confidential names or customer details, provide your own Crawlora API key, and account for billable requests.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The advisory concern does not establish overbroad authority: shell use is disclosed, and the helper enforces the documented research routes and methods despite lacking a tool declaration.
[SQP-2] expected: External searches are central to the requested workflow. A sensitive-query warning is absent, but the artifacts do not direct private-file collection or unrelated disclosure; this warrants privacy guidance rather than Review.
[E1] expected: The five advisory transmission flags concern the same documented Crawlora integration. Inspection found a fixed HTTPS destination, provider-specific authentication, and purpose-aligned request data rather than an unrelated exfiltration channel.
